List the provinces of a board

Source: R/map.R
dp_provinces.Rd

List the provinces of a board

Usage

dp_provinces(map = dp_map(), type = NULL)

Arguments

map

A dp_map object.

type

Optional filter: one or more of "land", "coast", "sea".

Value

A tibble with one row per province and columns code, name, type, supply_centre, home_power, x and y.

See also

Other setup: dp_adjacent(), dp_example_game(), dp_game, dp_game_from_units(), dp_home_centres(), dp_map(), dp_map-class, dp_new_game(), dp_unit(), dp_units(), is_dp_game(), is_dp_map()

Examples

dp_provinces(dp_map(), type = "sea")
